subject: Integration proposal: Sigil PromptSuite + Redwood tracing/SDK hooks
messages:
From: Ana Ruiz <ana@sigillabs.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
Cc: Sigil Labs Partnerships <partners@sigillabs.com>
Date: 2026-06-10T13:15:00-04:00
Subject: Integration proposal: Sigil PromptSuite + Redwood tracing/SDK hooks

Hi Connor,

I'm Ana, head of partnerships at Sigil Labs. We're building PromptSuite, a testing and prompt-quality toolkit teams use alongside LangChain and LlamaIndex. Several mutual customers have asked for deeper tracing to correlate prompts, retrieved results, and token usage across the stack. We think a lightweight instrumentation adapter and an SDK shim would make integration frictionless for ISVs and customers.

High-level ask:
- Can Redwood provide a recommended tracing contract (span names, tags) for LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters?
- Are you open to a co-engineered adapter that lives in Sigil's repo but follows Redwood's trace contract + optional prompt-quality telem?

We can propose a 2-week pilot: technical spike, sample dataset, and a short UX to visualize traces in your Console. Attached is a short one-pager describing Sigil's PromptSuite.

Would you be open to a quick 30-min call next week to align on scope and owners?

Thanks,
Ana Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, Sigil Labs
---
Attachment: promptsuite-onepager.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana@sigillabs.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration proposal: Sigil PromptSuite + Redwood tracing/SDK hooks

Hi Ana — great to meet you over email and thanks for the one-pager.

This is exactly the sort of ISV integration we want to encourage. Quick answers up-front:
- Yes — Redwood can share a tracing contract for SDK/adapter spans (we have a stable set of span names and tags we prefer for prompt/embedding calls).
- Co-engineering model sounds right: Sigil owns the adaptor code, we review/verify and list the adapter in our ISV catalog.

Proposed next steps:
1) Intro call (30 min) — technical + PM. I'll loop in Vanessa from Partnerships and Karthik (technical lead) for the call.
2) We'll share an internal adapter checklist and a minimal trace contract doc ahead of the call.
3) If both sides are aligned, a 2-week spike in a Sigil dev sandbox, with a post-spike canary to validate Console traces.

I'm attaching our 'ISV Instrumentation Checklist' and a short trace contract excerpt.

On availability — I'm free Tue/Wed mornings PST. What works for you?

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-isv-instrumentation-checklist.pdf
Attachment: trace-contract-excerpt.md

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Ana Ruiz <ana@sigillabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-11T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration proposal: Integration details + sandbox access

Looping in Karthik for the deep dive. A few technical notes to kick off:
- Recommended approach: instrument at the LangChain LLM/Tool call layer and at the LlamaIndex retriever layer. Two spans per request: prompt_generation and retrieval_match.
- We prefer payload redaction for PII at the adapter boundary; we'll share our redaction helpers.
- Token accounting: include token_count and model_variant tags to help cost attribution.

Can Sigil provide a sandbox org API key and a small example repo (or a zip) that reproduces a typical LangChain flow? We'll validate traces and provide feedback within 3 business days.

Thanks — Marissa
